title: The Complete Guide to Notion MCP: Connect Your Notion Workspace to AI Agents | Procedure Blog

facts.fact: The Notion MCP guide was published on January 23, 2026, and the page lists a reading time of 9 minutes.
The page lists Node.js version 20 as a prerequisite for the Notion MCP server, with the latest LTS release recommended.
The page's example .env configuration sets the Notion-Version header to 2022-06-28.
In the page's example, the Notion MCP server started with HTTP transport on port 8000 is reachable at http://localhost:8000/mcp.
facts.quote: This starts the Notion MCP server at:

facts.fact: The page lists seven example tool operations that the open-source Notion MCP server exposes.
facts.quote: The server comes feature-rich out of the box and supports the most common operations you’d need for general-purpose work.

facts.fact: The page states that the open-source Notion MCP server used in the guide is maintained by Notion.
facts.quote: For this example, we’ll use the [**open-source Notion MCP server**]

facts.fact: The tool API-post-search is described on the page as searching for a page by title.
facts.quote: `API-post-search` → Search for a page by title.

facts.fact: The page states that many MCP servers run over stdio transport by default, and the guide's setup uses HTTP transport instead.
facts.quote: By default, many MCP servers run on **stdio** transport for tools like Cursor or Claude.
